title: Judith E Probable NDE 6821
content: When the nurse finished reading the message, I was suddenly no longer aware of my body or the room. I began seeing familiar pictures of Jesus that I had loved as a child. In my mind, I asked why I was seeing this since I was no longer a traditional Christian. Immediately I heard a physical voice, my voice, but I wasn't aware of my talking. The voice told me the pictures were to calm me since they were favorite pictures as a child. I was also told it was the process that was important and it would be good for me to meditate for about fifteen minutes daily. As soon as I was told this, the pictures disappeared and there was an immensely bright light a short distance from me. I could feel only what could be true, unconditional love from the light for me. I actually became part of the light. I felt so loved that I could do nothing to diminish this love. It was the most awesome feeling I have ever experienced. This love was not an emotion; it was a state of being. At that point, I became aware of the room, nurses, my body, and my bed. The asthma had let up and I could lay down for the first time in almost a week. I loved my bed, pillow, and felt love for everything around me and couldn't wait to tell anyone within earshot what had just happened to me. I could breathe and all the vital signs had normalized to some extent. I told my doctor and two friends who relayed similar experiences which made me realize this experience was a normal process that was there for anyone.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: She reports seeing familiar pictures of Jesus she loved as a child.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: She was told it would be good for her to meditate for about fifteen minutes daily.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Asthma episode ("The asthma had let up...")

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: She states she was "no longer a traditional Christian" at the time.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: She reports seeing pictures of Jesus, hearing guidance in her own voice, encountering an immensely bright light with unconditional love, and then becoming aware of her body/room again.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Transition from room awareness to images of Jesus and guidance, then bright light/unconditional love, then abrupt return to room/body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: She reports hearing a "physical voice" that was her own voice speaking guidance while she was not aware of talking; and that the Jesus images were shown specifically to calm her based on childhood favorites. She also reports "actually became part of the light."
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "there was an immensely bright light a short distance from me. I could feel only what could be true, unconditional love from the light for me. I actually became part of the light."
